story.title: Hexaware Q1 CY26 Net Profit Rises 7.5% to Rs 352 Crore as European and Banking Segments Drive Growth
story.summary: Hexaware Technologies posted a 7.5% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 351.6 crore in Q1 CY26, beating analyst expectations, with revenue growing 12.6% to Rs 3,613 crore. Growth was led by strong performance in Europe and the banking and financial services vertical. The company maintained its full-year revenue growth guidance of 7.6%, suggesting steady demand for its AI-augmented IT services.
